text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Now then, it's almost time.
Don't worry, it won't go like last time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Today, I will run more freely
and with more passion than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Because above all, crossing the finish line
and feeling like it wasn't any fun...
is the most frustrating thing ever!
choice_data_list: Go give it everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Got it! Well, I'm off to have some fun!
